title: Home Tunnel 10.0.0 aggregate candidate evidence
description: A gate or ui_coverage may instead be {status: waived, waiver: {approved_by: owner, approved_at, reason, disclosed_in}} with no measured result; a waiver is not a pass. The record status is passed with no waivers and accepted_with_waivers otherwise. Non-waived gates fail closed unless all four source SHAs, artifact digests, the immutable api-v1.4.0 contract, full Gemini UI coverage, and every required VM, network, migration, 30-repeat, recovery, 2h, and 24h gate are present and matched. Do not store a fixture in this shape as acceptance evidence.
